Abandoning Ship- By Omnis Omnibus

So quickly did the storm come and devour our boat.

Now I am a refugee on this island, a small land called Voat.

As our ship burned, united did we moan

But 199,233 sailors, have found their new home.

"So long dear Snoo," So said my note

"But I have traded an alien in for a goat."

"We have abandoned our ship as the waves broke the bow,"

"Its end did not come with a bang, but a Pao."

(199,233 is the number of people that have signed a certain petition upon me writing this)
